page: Google Cloud Platform ct5l-hightpu-4t is an accelerator-optimized server designed specifically for machine learning and deep learning workloads. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 112 dedicated vCPUs and 192 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 1.71 GB of RAM per core. The defining characteristic of this server is the integration of 4 Google TPU v5e accelerators, which provide a combined 64 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all data persistence must be handled via network-attached storage solutions. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The hardware profile is highly specialized, trading off local storage and massive system memory capacity to maximize accelerator density. This design provides qualitative cost efficiency for distributed machine learning workloads where TPU-to-vCPU performance ratios are the primary driver of throughput.

The ct5l-hightpu-4t is engineered for workloads such as transformer-based neural network training, large language model inference, and intensive data science pipelines that leverage Google TPU hardware.
